0.title: Phonics Foundations
0.summary: You are building the sound patterns needed to read simple English words.

1.title: First Words
1.summary: You understand familiar classroom words and very short English patterns.
can: answer with one word or a short phrase

2.title: Simple Sentences
2.summary: You can understand and use short sentences about familiar things.
can: talk about names, objects and likes

3.title: Everyday English
3.summary: You can handle common questions and simple everyday information.
can: understand basic time and place language

4.title: Building Longer Answers
4.summary: You can connect simple ideas and understand a wider range of beginner English.
can: use common present and past patterns

5.title: Independent Beginner
5.summary: You can communicate about familiar topics with reasonable independence.
can: talk about past and future plans

6.title: Growing Communicator
6.summary: You can explain ideas, give reasons and understand moderately detailed English.

7.title: Confident Communicator
7.summary: You can understand and produce connected English on familiar and some unfamiliar topics.
can: understand implied meaning in simple contexts

8.title: Strong English User
8.summary: You can deal with detailed English and express ideas with good range.

9.title: Advanced English User
9.summary: You can understand sophisticated English and communicate detailed ideas clearly.

10.title: Highly Proficient
10.summary: You show strong control across demanding English tasks.
can: use a wide range of structures
